entries.reason: A development seed, with its text beside its digest: a development seed is looked at freely and never judged, so it is no secret, and a signal comparison started from the application runs on it with no file of seeds beside the server. The episode it names is drawn from a SHA-256 of its text under the comparison's own prefix, which its digest does not reveal, so its departures and dwells are drawn apart from every other seed's.
